meta.title: CareFlow companion
meta.description: Check in, answer care questions, and follow your visit on your phone. Research prototype.

claim.title: Your visit. Your phone.
claim.intro: Register your hospital visit on your phone, then follow your place in the queue.
claim.invalid: The code has at least 16 characters.
claim.failed: This code did not work. It may have expired; ask reception for a new one.
claim.status: See my place in the queue
claim.noCode: Scan your visit QR code again, or enter the handover code.
claim.unavailable: We could not reach the clinic. Check your connection and try again.
claim.expired: Your phone session has ended. Ask reception to reconnect.
claim.connectHelp: Scan your hand-over QR to resume. If scanning isn’t available, paste your hand-over code below.
claim.codeHint: Use the complete handover code shown on the welcome screen.
claim.scanTitle: Scan to start on your phone
claim.scanHelp: Scan the “Start on your phone” QR on the hospital welcome screen to begin. No account password is needed.

status.title: Your place in the queue
status.noToken: You do not have a queue number yet.
status.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Scan a new welcome QR or ask reception to reconnect.
status.failed: Your status could not be loaded.
status.paused: Live updates paused; checking every 15 seconds.
status.stale: We could not refresh your status. This is the last one we had.
status.intro: Your queue information updates here. Keep this page open while you wait.
status.nextWaiting: Watch for your number. Your room will appear here when the clinic calls you.
status.nextReview: A nurse will review your answers before your place in the queue is confirmed.
status.nextIntake: Continue your check-in to send your answers to the nurse.
status.waitNote: Wait times are estimates and may change as the clinic responds to patient needs.
status.receptionHelp: If you need help, speak to the reception desk.

intake.failed: Your answer did not go through. Please try again.
intake.done: Your check-in answers have been received. Please stay in the waiting area.
intake.status: See my place in the queue
intake.recoveryNeeded: We could not check whether your answer was received. Reconnect to continue safely.
intake.helper: The follow-up questions adapt to your answers. A nurse reviews the result.
intake.reviewHelp: Your queue number and room will appear on your visit status when they are available.
intake.privateHint: Your answers help the nurse understand your visit.
intake.processingAnswer: Saving your answer and preparing the next question…

complaint.help: Describe the main symptom or concern in your own words. Include when it started if you can.
complaint.example: Example: My ankle has been sore since yesterday.

onset.help: An approximate date or time is fine. If you don’t remember, say you’re not sure.
onset.example: For example: about two hours ago, or yesterday morning.

location.help: Name the part of the body, and the side if you know it.

scale.help: Choose a number from 0 to 10 that best matches how it feels now. Use your own words if a number is difficult.
scale.example: Describe how it feels, or enter a number from 0 to 10.

allergies.help: Check the question carefully. You can name an allergy or explain a change in the answer box.
allergies.example: Enter an allergy, a correction, or “not sure”.

child.help: Answer about the child you are checking in for. Choose “Not sure” if you cannot tell.
child.example: Tell us what you have noticed about your child.

choice.help: Choose the answer that fits what is happening now, or add details in your own words.
choice.example: Add details here if the choices do not explain your answer.

general.help: A short answer is enough. It is okay to say you don’t know.

ankle.label: Ankle pain
ankle.text: My ankle has been sore since yesterday.

headache.label: Headache
headache.text: I have had a headache since this morning.

results.label: Test results
results.text: I am here to discuss my recent test results.

feelsWorse.title: Tell the nurse what changed
feelsWorse.fastQuestion: Face drooping, arm weak or speech difficult?
feelsWorse.told: The nurse has been told. Stay where you are.
feelsWorse.failed: We couldn't reach the nurse. Tell the reception desk now.
feelsWorse.support: Something changed? Let the nurse know.
feelsWorse.selectHint: Select anything that applies, or tell the nurse in your own words.
feelsWorse.prototype: Research prototype. Synthetic data only. Not for clinical use.

child.drowsyQuestion: Is your child very hard to wake, or confused?

rag.refusal: I can't answer medical questions. I've told the nurse, who will speak with you.

status.ended: This visit has ended. If you feel worse, tell the reception desk now.
status.missed: We called your number and could not find you. Please go to the reception desk now.

ask.title: Ask the clinic
ask.label: A question about your visit or the clinic
ask.dontKnow: I don't know that one. Please ask at the reception desk.
ask.unavailable: Questions are not available right now. Please ask at the reception desk.
ask.intro: Practical help with your visit, from the clinic’s information.
ask.placeholder: For example, where is the pharmacy?
ask.hint: For a change in how you feel, use “I feel worse” below.
ask.hoursQuestion: What are the clinic opening hours?

start.consentIntro: A few clear choices before we start your visit.
start.identityIntro: Use the same six-digit patient code you would enter at the kiosk.
start.patientIntro: This helps us ask the right questions for the patient.
start.privacy: This phone flow uses typed answers. Your camera and microphone will stay off.
start.dataUse: With your permission, we use your patient record and the answers you provide to prepare your visit for the clinic team.
start.review: A nurse reviews the information and confirms the urgency of every visit. This prototype does not provide medical advice.
start.agree: I agree to my record and answers being used for this visit.
start.decline: If you prefer not to continue, speak to reception for help.
start.idHint: Use the code given at reception. For this demo, use 100005. This is not an account password.
start.childDetail: I’m checking in as a parent or guardian.
start.missingTitle: Scan the welcome QR to begin
start.missing: Scan “Start on your phone” on the hospital welcome screen. This connects your phone to the care team.
start.invalid: Check the six-digit patient code and try again.
start.expired: This QR code has expired. Scan a fresh code on the hospital welcome screen.
start.busy: The hospital is still processing this request, or the code is in use. Retry the same visit or ask reception for help.
start.notFound: We couldn’t find that patient code. Check it and try again, or ask reception.
start.unavailable: We couldn’t reach the clinic. Your choices are still here; try again.
start.limited: Too many attempts. Wait one minute and try again, or ask reception for help.

reception.consentTitle: Welcome. Let’s get you checked in.
reception.consentIntro: Register your visit on your phone. It takes just a few simple steps.
reception.detailsIntro: Enter the patient’s details so our reception team can prepare the visit.
reception.careIntro: Select a department and tell us if you have a doctor preference.
reception.visitIntro: Tell the care team the purpose of your visit and anything that needs attention.
reception.reviewIntro: Review your details before sending them to reception.
reception.privacyTitle: Your details, used for this visit
reception.privacy: Registration uses the information you enter here. Your microphone and camera stay off.
reception.dataUse: We’ll share your registration with the reception and clinical team to help them prepare your visit.
reception.nurseReview: A nurse reviews any urgent concerns. Registration does not provide a diagnosis or confirm an appointment.
reception.agree: I agree to my details being used to register and prepare this visit.
reception.decline: Prefer to register in person? Our reception team can help.
reception.name: Patient’s full name
reception.syntheticHint: This is a demonstration. Use synthetic patient details only.
reception.departmentHint: Choose the service you want to visit. The care team will confirm where you should be seen.
reception.doctorHint: A preference is a request, not a confirmed booking.
reception.demoDirectory: Demo care directory. Doctors and availability are fictional.
reception.directoryFailed: We couldn’t load the departments. Try again, or speak to reception.

departmentHints.paediatrics: Care for babies, children and teens

reception.reasonPlaceholder: For example, follow-up for knee pain, or discussing recent test results.
reception.reasonHint: A short description is enough. You can explain more to the care team.
reception.urgencyHint: Select any of these symptoms that are happening now. Leave unchecked if none apply.
reception.emergencyHelp: Need immediate help? Tell reception or a member of staff now. Don’t wait to finish this form.
reception.submitHint: Your registration will be sent for nurse review. Your queue details will appear once the care team confirms the next step.
reception.retryLocked: We couldn’t confirm the result. Retry to check the same registration; your details will not be submitted as a second visit.
reception.invalid: Check your details and try again. If the problem continues, speak to reception.
reception.receivedHint: The care team has these visit details. Your doctor preference will be confirmed by staff.

identityFlow.identityIntro: Use your mobile number or patient ID if you have visited before. New here? You can register below.
identityFlow.verifyTitle: Check that this is your record
identityFlow.verifyIntro: One more detail helps us protect your health information.
identityFlow.recipientIntro: You can check in for yourself or support someone in your care.
identityFlow.detailsIntro: These details must belong to the person receiving care today.
identityFlow.preferencesTitle: Do you have a care preference?
identityFlow.preferencesIntro: You can leave this to the care team. Your answers will help them understand the visit.
identityFlow.consentTitle: Ready to tell us what’s wrong?
identityFlow.consentIntro: The assistant asks a few questions, one at a time. A nurse reviews your answers.
identityFlow.lookupPermission: I agree to use these details to find my patient record.
identityFlow.newPatientHint: First visit, or no record to look up?
identityFlow.identityBoundary: This demo uses synthetic patient records. Full details are shown only after verification.
identityFlow.verifyHint: Enter the year of birth recorded for this person.
identityFlow.notMyRecord: This is not my record — register instead

child.label: A child
child.hint: Under 16, with a parent or carer

identityFlow.prefilledHint: Please check the information from your verified record.
identityFlow.dependentHint: Enter the patient’s own details below. Your record is used only to identify you as their supporting person.
identityFlow.historyHint: Tell the nurse if anything is missing or has changed.
identityFlow.historyPartial: Some record information is unavailable. The nurse will confirm the details.
identityFlow.unsureDepartment: Let the care team guide me
identityFlow.unsureHint: You do not need to choose a department.
identityFlow.chooseDepartment: I have a department or doctor preference
identityFlow.adaptiveIntro: Tell the assistant about the problem in your own words. It uses your answers to choose the next question and prepares a summary for the nurse.
identityFlow.dataPermission: I agree to use this patient’s details and answers for this visit.
identityFlow.voiceHint: Hold the microphone button to speak. Your recording is processed by the local voice service. You can always type instead.
identityFlow.urgentHint: Select any symptoms happening now. Starting will alert the nurse as well as open your visit. Tell reception immediately if you need help.
identityFlow.retryLocked: Your request may already have arrived. Retry to safely resume the same visit.
identityFlow.clinicalBoundary: The assistant does not diagnose. A nurse reviews your information and determines urgency.
identityFlow.noMatch: We could not find a matching record. Check the details or register as a new patient.
identityFlow.verificationFailed: We could not verify that record. Check the year of birth or ask reception for help.
identityFlow.invalid: Check the patient details and try again.

earlyUrgent.title: Get nurse help without finishing check-in
earlyUrgent.intro: You can send a help request now without entering a name or completing these screens. Tell reception immediately if you need help.
earlyUrgent.child: This request is for a child under 16
earlyUrgent.permission: I agree to share this help request with the care team.
earlyUrgent.failed: Your request is not confirmed yet. Retry the same request or tell reception immediately.

holdToTalk.title: Voice answer
holdToTalk.hint: Press and hold this button, or hold the Space bar. Speak in the language you selected, then release. Up to 30 seconds per answer.
holdToTalk.privacy: Your microphone is off until you hold. Audio is processed locally and is not saved.
holdToTalk.tryAgain: Microphone setup stopped when you released. Hold again and speak when Listening appears.
holdToTalk.noSpeech: We did not hear a clear answer. Hold again, or type your answer.
holdToTalk.failed: Voice is unavailable right now. You can try again or type your answer.
holdToTalk.secureContext: Voice needs a secure HTTPS connection on your phone. You can type your answer below.

patientReceipt.title: Your visit, ready for the care team
patientReceipt.referenceHint: Keep this reference. Your queue token appears after the nurse reviews your visit.
patientReceipt.alertTitle: Priority alert recorded for the nurse
patientReceipt.alertHint: Please alert a nearby member of staff now. You may continue adding information if you can; do not wait for measurements to seek help.
patientReceipt.notDiagnosis: This prototype suggestion is not a diagnosis or a decision to wait. A nurse confirms your priority.
patientReceipt.noSuggestion: A nurse will review your answers. No model suggestion is available yet.
patientReceipt.cameraStatus: Phone camera is off. No camera assessment was recorded.
patientReceipt.unavailable: Your receipt could not refresh. Your saved visit is unchanged.
patientReceipt.warnings: Some information needs the nurse’s review.
patientReceipt.assistanceTitle: Urgent help request recorded for the nurse
